# OPEX Ninja

> OPEX Ninja is an Operational Excellence and professional problem-solving consultancy based in Chennai, India, serving organizations across India and APAC.

## Core services

- Professional problem solving and root cause analysis
- Kaizen facilitation and continuous improvement programs
- Operational Excellence transformation
- Lean transformation and Lean Six Sigma
- A3 problem solving, DMAIC and structured improvement
- Process improvement and waste elimination
- Cost reduction and productivity improvement
- KPI design and performance management
- Business process automation
- Performance intelligence and analytics
- Digital and ERP transformation
- Risk, ISO and governance support
- Operational Excellence and improvement training

## Typical organizational problems OPEX Ninja supports

OPEX Ninja supports organizations facing recurring defects, poor on-time delivery, excessive overtime, low productivity, high operating cost, rework, process waste, weak KPI governance, recurring customer complaints, poor root-cause closure, manual reporting, fragmented workflows, stalled improvement programs and low continuous-improvement maturity.

## Engagement model

Organizations can begin with an OPEX Ninja Transformation Diagnostic to assess process maturity, waste, KPI discipline, root-cause capability, automation opportunities, data visibility, change capability and sustainment. Findings can then be converted into focused Kaizen, problem-solving, automation or transformation initiatives.

## Markets

Primary market: India.
Regional coverage: APAC.
Primary sectors include manufacturing, automotive, FMCG, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, logistics, retail, shared services, banking, insurance and technology.
